summary: PR #45067 (TAT-3490) — perps withdraw/cancel reliability, rebased onto origin/main 5b44454253 and through two self-review fix passes. The recipe now runs GREEN END-TO-END on this slot: mm-harness run reports status pass, 28/28 nodes, against a dist rebuilt from the current tree — so AC1 and AC2 are proven live rather than carried forward, and the 'after' screenshot below is this run's own capture. Earlier revisions of these artifacts claimed the recipe halted at setup-select-account on a production LavaMoat build; that was a stale checklist invocation (--launch-existing-dist / --project-root), not a runtime defect, and is superseded. AC3 (the fresh-read stale-balance guard) is unit-proven only — a suspended service worker cannot currently be staged in a recipe — and that is the one real coverage gap, documented in recipe-coverage.md. Latest pass: the blocked withdrawal now always surfaces a reason instead of silently no-opping when the stream ticks mid-read, and the UI-side already-closed cancel event was removed because the controller already emits one for the same attempt. 69/69 unit tests across the two changed suites; mm-harness check diff --profile fast green.

standalone.label: Before: cancel dialog stays open showing the raw provider prose "cancel 0: Order was never placed, already canceled, or filled. asset=4" in both the in-modal error banner and a "Failed to cancel order" toast

After (captured by this run, node 24/28): the modal is dismissed, the ETH market page shows no error banner, and a green-check toast reads "This order is no longer open". The capture is gated behind a ui.wait_for on the perps-toast-cancel-order-already-closed testId, so it cannot be taken before the asserted element exists.
